author: root

silhouette.reason: Compact shorts/shoe bands and wider dense face correct the v4 thin-stilt proportions. Against Brendan/May/Red the back hair remains a heavy rectangular wall, the vest a box, and profiles retain a long tapered face/neck wedge. A recognizable serviceable human, not a finished expressive silhouette.

anatomy.reason: The short lower body and connected forearms are credible. However front eyes repeat pale outer columns(x4/x10) with dark inner pupils(x5/x9) on two rows, creating bright convergent stripes rather than the references compact dark eyes. Profile nose/cheek/jaw/neck is a stretched tapered skin wedge, with little separate cheek/chin mass or shoulder integration.

walking.reason: All directions have genuine alternating support/swing feet and opposite arm action; connected compact limbs improve native readability. Shoes still read as rectangular blocks rather than coherent rolling toe/heel clusters, and side idle merges the lower mass into a uniform sole. Profile occlusion is permitted; the problem is missing near/far shoe shape and clothing overlap, not the mere absence of an alpha gap.

pixelCraft.reason: Darker contours and improved value spread help. Yet large flat chest, repeated eye strips, a nearly uniform back hair wall and horizontal pack stripes give schematic blocks. Reference pixels describe connected planes through selective outline breaks, warm facial shadow/cheek clusters, and cloth/shoe overlap; matching total opacity does not supply those relationships.

identity.reason: Cap, vest and gold-red pack stay coherent. Front vest lacks a readable opening/collar/hem design, while side pack is a narrow gold mass near the elbow and back pack a striped plaque; it does not yet convey the reference-level shaped attached accessory volume. Costume colors are present but character design is underresolved.

directionContinuity.reason: The same hero and costume turn consistently, with clear front/back/profile heading. Profile neck and pack width still make the turn feel flatter and narrower than the front/back volume.

loop.reason: All four140ms frames decode, all16native pose comparisons match, gutters remain transparent, idle1/3 repeat and no file-level seam or unexplained root jump appears in the full decoded sequence. This continuity score does not approve the weaker pose and cluster craft.

reviewIndependence: Same-model organizational/task separation only; no different-model/decorrelated quality judgment is claimed.
referenceEvidence: All36Emerald reference poses at1x/4x plus Brendan/May/Red/v4/v5 idle comparison at1x/5x. Nintendo references are external inspection material only.

frontIdleMeasurements.interpretation: Lower mass is materially improved. These diagnostics are not added numerical gates: v5total218opaque pixels versus214Brendan/May shows equal area can still have weaker clusters.

requiredCorrections: Rebuild the frontal eyes as compact dark eye/upper-lid clusters with restrained highlights; remove the repeated outer-white/inner-pupil stripes that imply a convergent bright gaze. Shape forehead/cheek/chin around the eyes rather than treating extra white as detail.
Shorten and round the profile lower face/neck transition; integrate chin and collar/shoulder so the head does not taper into a long pointed wedge.
Shape back hair with a tapered nape and a few coherent value planes/edge breaks; avoid the tall near-uniform rectangular dark wall.

Redesign vest collar/opening/hem and near/far arm overlap as connected clothing forms. Widen/deepen side pack enough to match its back-view mass; place attachment behind the shoulder/elbow instead of reading as a gold block against the arm.

Redraw planted/swing shoe toe/heel forms and side near/far overlap using one stable footwear design. Preserve genuine alternation and compact legs; do not add obligatory alpha gaps or exact copied reference pixels.
scope: Read-only source/art/store inspection plus requested review reports. No code, artwork, historical approval or canonical data changed.
